market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$104 needs +35% to hit $140 (1-min high) by end of June. Recent geopolitical risk has only produced a brief move to ~$110. A move of this magnitude in 60 days requires a major supply shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan supply shock from Middle East war.
